title: What a Full Writing-Improvement System Must Do
purpose: Document the concrete competitor capability baseline without asserting unmeasured superiority.

claims.text: Grammarly Docs combines brainstorming, composition, grammatical review, and revision tools in an editor with multiple writing agents.
Grammarly describes a Citation Finder that searches for sources supporting or disputing passages.
WRITER describes agents that break a business goal into steps, retrieve organizational context, and create finished deliverables.
ProWritingAid advertises Story Canvas, plot analysis, writing sessions, line editing, and manuscript critique as connected writing stages.
LanguageTool offers JSON-oriented spelling and grammar checking with contextual rules and multiple languages.
Vale is a configurable markup-aware style linter designed for editor and CI workflows, not a comprehensive grammar teacher.
Markup AI, formerly Acrolinx, advertises content governance that checks brand consistency, quality, and citability before release.
